guide.bunnidogs.title: Bunnidogs Guide
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.title: Find a warren
guide.bunnidogs.page.2.body: Look for guava trees and entrance mounds. Follow lit tunnels to Nests. Settlements have one to five trees; cave, Nether and End lines have their own habitats. Maps: page 46. Scouts: page 47.
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.title: Genes and stats
guide.bunnidogs.page.3.body: Each of seven genes has two copies. Dominance picks the visible trait; hidden copies still pass to pups. Bred stat points are separate. Use Calipers to read both.
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.title: Breed a seed
guide.bunnidogs.page.4.body: Feed a guava to each of two ready adults. They drop one seed holding both parents. Its tooltip shows the planned litter, quality and stat drift. The parents then rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.title: Hatch the litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.5.body: Plant a seed on farmland; dispensers plant into air above it. Bone meal speeds growth; hand or dispenser Starlit Dust ripens it. Break the ripe crop to hatch pups. Fortune improves quality. Leave room.
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.title: Guava quality
guide.bunnidogs.page.6.body: Better guavas improve inherited stat gains. Feed both parents: their qualities are averaged. Golden: 1, Diamond: 2, Netherite: 4, Star: 7, Beacon: 12, Dragon Egg: 20.
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.title: Keep a pedigree
guide.bunnidogs.page.7.body: Log animals with a Pedigree Book; Ear Tags label them. Sneak-use with a filled basket in the other hand to log its animal. Normal use opens records. Filter contents by traits/tags or senses>=20; hover the field for syntax.
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.title: Nests and travel
guide.bunnidogs.page.8.body: Adults claim a reachable Nest and return at night. Lead an adult to a free Nest and use it to move home. Empty-hand use inspects the resident. Use a compass to mark a Nest; its place stays marked if removed.
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.title: Food and troughs
guide.bunnidogs.page.9.body: Guavas suit every line; other foods follow Diet. Fill a trough for healing. Injured adults can eat near their Nest at night; keep food and a safe route within four blocks of home. Sneak-empty withdraws stock.
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.title: Life at home
guide.bunnidogs.page.10.body: Healthy adults visit nearby bells at noon. Ring one to call a daytime visit. Keep it within 12 blocks of home, with walking space. Injury, threats, leads, rides and night interrupt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.title: Gentle sampling
guide.bunnidogs.page.11.body: Use a Sampling Syringe on an animal at half health or better. It yields one Tissue Sample without harm; recovery takes five minutes. Sneak-use Calipers for care readiness and timers.
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.title: Wool and whiskers
guide.bunnidogs.page.12.body: Shear a healthy woolly adult for two wool in coat colors. Brush adults at Senses +10 for one whisker. Each needs ten minutes of recovery. Tools wear once; pups yield neither.
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.title: Useful coats
guide.bunnidogs.page.13.body: Expressed ember resists fire and lava; moss prevents Poison; sand prevents cactus damage; void prevents Levitation. Hidden copies give no protection. Other dangers still matter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.title: Physical traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.14.body: Hoofed legs halve fall damage. Slate adds 4 armor. Stocky/chonker resist knockback by 15%/30%. Snow walks on powder snow; snow/woolly resist freezing. Glow is self-lit. Hidden traits give no benefit.
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.title: Laboratory
guide.bunnidogs.page.15.body: Put two Tissue Samples on a Genetics Table. Read the source sheets, pup forecast, copy odds and splice plans. Hidden copies count. Reading never spends samples.
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.title: Gene Splicer
guide.bunnidogs.page.16.body: Sneak-use to select a gene. Hold a donor sample in the other hand and carry Mutagen. Use on a healthy adult: one donor copy enters that gene. Costs one sample, Mutagen and tool use.
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.title: Stable lines
guide.bunnidogs.page.17.body: Register stable bred adults with matching copies in all seven genes and recorded parents. Use the Registry on an animal, or sneak-use with its filled basket in the other hand. Keeps 24 distinct lines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.title: Show Ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.18.body: Lead a stable bred adult to a Judging Stand. Use empty-handed or with a lead. Every stat needs +5 for bronze, +20 for silver, +50 for gold. Sneak-empty use previews; each tier pays only once.
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.title: Material drops
guide.bunnidogs.page.19.body: Death drops follow genes and bred points. Player kills unlock signatures and legends; pups give less. Pelts craft leather, sinew makes string, whiskers make Brushes and marrow makes Mutagen.
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.title: The five legends
guide.bunnidogs.page.20.body: At stat +100, adult player kills can drop a legend. Vitality: Titan Haunch; speed: Gilded Foot; Leap: Moon Sinew; Senses: Listening Shell; Bloom: Everbloom. More points improve the chance.
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.title: Apex ritual
guide.bunnidogs.page.21.body: Craft an Apex Crucible from seven obsidian, a Mutant Marrow and a diamond. Put all five distinct legends on Trophy Pedestals in its ring. Offer a Tissue Sample to choose the boss line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.title: The ritual ring
guide.bunnidogs.page.22.body: Use any five slots: three blocks N/E/S/W or two blocks diagonally, at crucible height. Leave dry space above it. Success spends the sample and five legends. The living donor stays safe.
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.title: Apex of the Line
guide.bunnidogs.page.23.body: Watch for its charge: dodge pounces and leave the four-block stomp. Half health enrages it. A player victory drops a crest that reads the original line or stands on a pedestal. Care tools refuse.
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.title: Guava juice
guide.bunnidogs.page.24.body: Craft a guava with a glass bottle. Hold a seed in the main hand and juice in the other, then use the seed to infuse it. The rolled pup genes determine the drink effects. Better seeds improve them.
message.bunnidogs.trough.tending.on: Gardening enabled. Healthy residents harvest; Bloom +10 also cultivates.
message.bunnidogs.trough.tending.off: Gardening disabled. Residents still eat stored food.
guide.bunnidogs.page.25.title: Trough gardening
guide.bunnidogs.page.25.body: Hoe-enable a trough. Healthy residents harvest matching ripe food, then rest a minute. Bloom +10 also advances unripe crops one stage. Diet, filters and mob griefing apply. Sweet berries regrow on the bush.
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.title: Furnished warrens
guide.bunnidogs.page.26.body: New dens have a trough with two guavas; levels 3-5 may fit a central bell. Grand-tree nurseries may fit an empty Cradle. New farm corners have empty enabled troughs. Use a hoe to enable work on crafted or old troughs.
message.bunnidogs.apex.missing_one: Missing offering: %s. Empty-hand use checks the ring.
message.bunnidogs.apex.missing_many: Missing offering: %s, and %s more. Empty-hand use lists them.
message.bunnidogs.apex.preview_hint: Use main-hand Calipers with a Tissue Sample in the other hand to forecast the Apex.

message.bunnidogs.apex.forecast_motion: Enraged pursuit: +%s%% speed. Pounce height: about %s blocks.
tooltip.bunnidogs.tissue.apex_preview: Main-hand Calipers on an Apex Crucible forecast this line.
guide.bunnidogs.page.27.title: Before the Apex
guide.bunnidogs.page.27.body: Hold Calipers in the main hand and a Tissue Sample in the other. Use an Apex Crucible for health, attacks and defenses. Empty-hand use lists missing offerings. Reading spends nothing.
message.bunnidogs.gardening.ready: ready to search; needs an enabled, unpowered trough, matching food, room and a safe route
message.bunnidogs.gardening.danger: paused by danger, seeking refuge or a recent attack
message.bunnidogs.gardening.outside_home: needs to be within 16 blocks of its Nest
guide.bunnidogs.page.28.title: Living harvests
guide.bunnidogs.page.28.body: Brush healthy adults: glow gives glowstone; starborn at Bloom +20 gives Starlit Dust; moss at Bloom +10 gives moss carpet. Senses +10 adds a whisker. Gather one of each match for one tool use and ten-minute recovery.
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.title: Terrain traits
guide.bunnidogs.page.29.body: Hoofed adults step up one-block ledges and take half fall damage. Fleet legs reduce soul-sand and honey slowing by 25%; lean builds by 50%. Together: 75%. Cobwebs, Slowness and other hazards remain.
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.title: Shore fishing
guide.bunnidogs.page.30.body: Hurt fisher adults hunt nearby cod, salmon or tropical fish. They need a Nest, daylight and a reachable fish. A kill heals 4 HP, then rests 30 seconds. Pufferfish and land prey are excluded.
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.title: Resident needs
guide.bunnidogs.page.31.body: Sneak-use Calipers for a claimed Nest, distance, foods and meal recovery. Healthy adults need no healing. Ready means ready to search, not a promise of nearby food. Reading changes nothing.
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.title: Find refuge
guide.bunnidogs.page.32.body: Non-feral residents retreat from visible threats to a safer dry spot near home. Meals and work pause. Leads and rides take over. Feral lines keep their retaliation. No safe route means no retreat.
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.title: Storm shelter
guide.bunnidogs.page.33.body: Idle adults wait under cover near their Nest during thunderstorms. Leave a dry floor, room to stand and a safe route. Meals, work, danger and player control take priority. Normal rain keeps idle routines.
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.title: Trough automation
guide.bunnidogs.page.34.body: Hoppers fill and drain troughs. Power the hopper to hold food. Stock: one matching stack, up to 16; comparators read 0 empty to 15 full. A hoe toggles gardening. Redstone pauses residents: page 49.
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.title: Bell calls
guide.bunnidogs.page.35.body: Ring a bell within 12 blocks of a Nest to call healthy adults by day. Redstone and projectiles work too. Leave safe walking space. Visits last up to 20 seconds, with a minute of rest. Leads and care take priority.
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.title: Fleece colors
guide.bunnidogs.page.36.body: Woolly adults yield two wool in their coat colors. Spotted gives one yellow and one brown. Glow gives cyan; moss green; ember red; void purple. Hidden coats add nothing. Calipers names the ready yield.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_set: Reserved for %s with matching components. Food was not consumed.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_conflict: Withdraw the different stored food before changing the filter.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filtered: Reserved for %s with matching components. Sneak-empty while empty clears the filter.
message.bunnidogs.trough.filter_cleared: Food filter cleared. This trough accepts any suitable food again.
guide.bunnidogs.page.37.title: Trough filters
guide.bunnidogs.page.37.body: Sneak-use food to reserve a trough for that exact food and its components, without spending it. Hoppers and gardeners obey the filter. Sneak-empty withdraws stock; repeat while empty to clear the filter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.title: Care dispensers
guide.bunnidogs.page.38.body: Dispensers use Brushes or Sampling Syringes on one eligible bunnidog ahead per pulse. One tool use; hand and machine share recovery. Collect drops with hoppers. Armadillo brushing still works.

message.bunnidogs.basket.released: Released safely; adults can claim a new Nest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.39.title: Travel Basket
guide.bunnidogs.page.39.body: Craft six planks, leather and a lead into a basket. Pack one calm, unled animal; release on clear dry ground. Identity and care rest persist; its old Nest becomes free. Calipers reads it; sneak-use books to log it.

message.bunnidogs.cradle.invalid: Stored item has no valid litter. Sneak-empty to recover it.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.growing: Stage %s/7; next in %ss. Sneak-empty withdraws and resets growth.

message.bunnidogs.cradle.refused: Hatching was refused. The litter is retained.
message.bunnidogs.cradle.hatched: Hatched %s pups. The Cradle is empty.
guide.bunnidogs.page.41.title: Nursery Cradle
guide.bunnidogs.page.41.body: Craft wool, glass, a Nest and planks into a Nursery Cradle. Insert one seed; a loaded minute adds one stage. Bone meal helps; Starlit Dust ripens it. Sneak-empty withdraws and resets growth. Calipers reads the litter.
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.title: Hatch safely
guide.bunnidogs.page.42.body: Use a ripe Cradle empty-handed or pulse redstone. Clear a dry 3x3 pad in front with two blocks of air. Sneak-Calipers checks the pad and marks trouble. Hoppers move seeds; comparators read 15 when ripe. Steady power does not repeat.
message.bunnidogs.crop.crowded: Too many bunnidogs nearby. The crop stays ripe until there is room.
message.bunnidogs.crop.refunded: Hatching was refused. The original litter seed has been returned.
guide.bunnidogs.page.43.title: Surplus compost
guide.bunnidogs.page.43.body: Bloom +10 adults compost food above an eight-item reserve at hoe-enabled troughs. Place a composter nearby with a safe route. Crop work takes priority. Each job spends one food and rests a minute. Hoppers collect bone meal.
tooltip.bunnidogs.mutagen.nursery: Use on a planted seed or Cradle, or dispense at it; keeps growth
guide.bunnidogs.page.44.title: Treat a litter
guide.bunnidogs.page.44.body: Use or dispense one Mutagen at a planted seed or occupied Cradle. Growth, incubation, parents, quality and item details stay intact. Treated or invalid litters keep the vial. You can treat a ripe litter before hatching.

message.bunnidogs.guarding.ready: ready to search for visible selected hostiles near home; safe routes required
message.bunnidogs.guarding.active: defending near home; sneak-use a bone to disable
guide.bunnidogs.page.45.title: Nest guards
guide.bunnidogs.page.45.body: Sneak-use a bone on a feral adult with a Nest to toggle guarding. No bone is spent. Free, half-healthy guards bite selected hostiles within eight blocks of home. Leads pause them. Calipers reports readiness. They can still be hurt.
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.title: Warren maps
guide.bunnidogs.page.46.body: Journeyman cartographers may sell a Warren Explorer Map for 14 emeralds and a compass. Follow its village marker to a natural Overworld warren. The trade is not guaranteed. Failed searches omit it. Cave dens and End warrens are excluded.

message.bunnidogs.scouting.health: A mineral scout needs at least half health.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.traits: Needs expressed bat ears and at least +10 bred Senses; hidden copies do not qualify.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.combat: Survey paused during combat or refuge.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.ready: ready; sneak-use a compass for nearby ore. At Senses +20, hold a mineral in the other hand to focus.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.none: No loaded %s within %s blocks. Survey rests 30 seconds; compass unchanged.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.marked: Compass marked %s at %s, %s, %s. The place remains marked after mining.
guide.bunnidogs.page.47.title: Mineral scouts
guide.bunnidogs.page.47.body: Sneak-use a compass on a half-healthy bat-eared adult with Senses +10. Marks ore through rock within six blocks. A survey rests 30 seconds, even when empty. Places stay after mining. Focused surveys: page 48.
message.bunnidogs.scouting.focus_require: Focused mineral surveys need at least +%s bred Senses. Clear the mineral from the other hand for a general survey.
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.title: Choose a mineral
guide.bunnidogs.page.48.body: Senses +20 scouts can focus: hold a mineral in the other hand. Raw metals/ingots select their ore; coal, redstone, lapis, gems, quartz or netherite scrap select theirs. No mineral is spent. Every focus shares the same survey rest.
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.title: Pause trough work
guide.bunnidogs.page.49.body: Power a Feeding Trough to pause resident meals, crops and composting. Stock, filters, hoppers and comparator output still work. Remove power to resume at the next search. The hoe keeps its setting. Empty-hand inspection names the pause.
advancement.bunnidogs.standing_watch.des: Ask a feral adult with a Nest to guard its home.
advancement.bunnidogs.quiet_listener.des: Ask a bat-eared adult bred to Senses +10 to mark nearby ore on a compass.
advancement.bunnidogs.discerning_ear.des: Use a mineral cue with a Senses +20 bat-eared scout to find that ore family.
screen.bunnidogs.records.filter_help: Filter contents: tag or trait words; shown:bat, carried:glow, adult, pup; senses>=20, bloom<10 or speed=5. Space-separated terms all match. Clear to restore. Original record numbers and parent links stay intact.
